description: Standard envelope for Skill/runtime artifacts. Structural contract only; values and references remain caller-supplied.

evidence: Evidence reference; not proof by itself
fields.payload_sha256: Optional SHA-256 of canonical payload bytes

security_notes: Never put secrets or raw credentials in envelopes, payloads, logs, or evidence references.
Do not claim independent verification solely because this structural validator passed.
A Git SHA is a supplied identifier until a trusted host resolves it against an approved checkout.
